items.name: compare-curtain
items.title: Compare Curtain
items.description: A draggable divider that reveals two aligned images or design states.

useCases: Before-and-after images, design revisions, and visual product comparisons.
limitations: Horizontal comparison only. The caller supplies aligned layers with matching dimensions.
requirements: Requires React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4. Supply accessible descriptions for images inside each layer. The divider supports pointer, touch, and keyboard input.

items.name: peel-stack
items.title: Peel Stack
items.description: A layered paper stack that rotates through collections with buttons, arrow keys, or a swipe.

useCases: Layered collections, portfolio studies, and attachment cards with manual navigation.
limitations: Shows up to three visible layers. Cards have a fixed height; increase it for long content. Demo artwork is not installed.
requirements: Supply items with unique IDs. Uses React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and theme tokens. Inactive cards are inert; reduced motion disables transitions.

items.name: ascii-morph
items.title: ASCII Morph
items.description: A cloud of characters that morphs into a globe, a flower, and an A1 monogram.

useCases: Interactive ASCII illustrations for landing pages, portfolios, and identity studies.
limitations: Three built-in silhouettes only: globe, flower, and A1. Does not convert images or arbitrary text into ASCII.
requirements: React and Tailwind CSS. Uses SVG, requestAnimationFrame, matchMedia, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion switches shapes instantly. No automatic animation or pause control is needed.

items.name: ascii-lens
items.title: ASCII Lens
items.description: An image rendered as ASCII, with a circular lens that reveals the original.

useCases: Portfolio and product cards that reveal source artwork through an interactive lens.
limitations: Remote images must allow canvas pixel reads through CORS; otherwise ASCII sampling falls back to the original image.
requirements: Supply an image URL and alt text. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Remote images need anonymous CORS permission for ASCII sampling.

items.name: integration-hub
items.title: Integration Hub
items.description: A connected workspace with six tools and animated pulses flowing into a central product.

useCases: Product integration diagrams with up to six tools, inward pulses, and optional tool selection.
limitations: Visualization only. No account connections, synchronization, or live activity data. Extra tools beyond six are ignored.
requirements: Supply tools with unique IDs and a product. Icons are React nodes. Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Reduced motion retains static connections.

items.name: ascii-terrain
items.title: ASCII Terrain
items.description: A landscape made of characters, with rolling hills, pointer sculpting, and click ripples.

useCases: Interactive ASCII landscapes and decorative hero backgrounds.
limitations: Procedural illustration only. No geographic data or persistent terrain editing. JavaScript is required to draw.
requirements: Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion shows a static landscape.

items.name: text-banner
items.title: Text Banner
items.description: Bold text and staggered pixel separators in a seamless, infinitely scrolling banner.

useCases: Continuously scrolling words or phrases with separators for page banners.
limitations: Plain text only. Repeated content is decorative and cannot contain links or controls.
requirements: Supply items and a pause control using the paused prop. Requires ResizeObserver. Reduced motion displays one static sequence.

items.name: confirmation-button
items.title: Confirmation Button
items.description: A drag-to-confirm button with a dotted arrow, pending feedback, and a confirmed state.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions with drag, keyboard, and asynchronous feedback.
limitations: The app supplies the action. Dragging is left to right, and success stays visible until remount.
requirements: Requires React 19.2 or later. Supply onConfirm. Return a promise for asynchronous work and reject it to allow retry. Change the React key to reset.

items.name: shape-flow
items.title: Shape Flow
items.description: Text that reflows around a floating ASCII duck, powered by Pretext.

useCases: Editorial text wrapping around a floating ASCII duck.
limitations: One left-to-right plain-text paragraph. Rich text and right-to-left flow are unsupported.
requirements: Use a loaded named font. Interactive layout needs Canvas 2D, Intl.Segmenter, and ResizeObserver.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Reveals new text from left to right through a scramble of random characters.

useCases: Animating changing headings, labels, or status text through scrambled characters.
limitations: The initial text does not animate. Animation starts when the text prop changes.
requirements: Update the text prop to animate. Use a monospace font to reduce width shifts.

items.name: section-rail
items.title: Section Rail
items.description: A compact reading rail that tracks progress through page sections.

useCases: Table of contents and reading progress for long pages with sections.
limitations: Tracks existing DOM sections; it does not create the page content.
requirements: Match every item ID to a section element on the page.

items.name: spiral-text
items.title: Spiral Text
items.description: Text set on a responsive spiral that tightens under pressure and ripples on release.

useCases: Decorative spiral typography with pointer interaction.
limitations: A decorative text composition, not a reading paragraph or changing-label effect.
requirements: Supply text and room for the responsive spiral.

items.name: particle-menu
items.title: Particle Menu
items.description: Grainy symbols that scatter around your pointer and spring back into place.

useCases: Artistic navigation with interactive particle symbols.
limitations: A specialized visual navigation treatment, not a general dropdown selector.
requirements: Supply labeled items with supported shapes and navigation destinations.

items.name: arc-reel
items.title: Arc Reel
items.description: An infinitely looping reel with curved provider cards and synchronized scroll controls.

useCases: Looping galleries, provider cards, or logo reels with drag and keyboard controls.
limitations: Supply your own artwork; demo images are not installed.
requirements: Theme tokens --background, --foreground, --border, and --muted-foreground must exist.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A copy button that animates its icon and label into a checkmark and copied confirmation.

useCases: Copying text, links, and code with animated success feedback.
limitations: Copies plain text only. Clipboard access requires HTTPS or localhost and browser permission.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply value. Reduced motion skips the transitions.

items.name: loading-button
items.title: Loading Button
items.description: A loading button with animated icon and label transitions for async actions and network requests.

useCases: Submitting data, saving changes, and running network requests with loading, success, and retry feedback.
limitations: Runs the supplied action on click. Does not submit forms automatically or cancel requests. Success resets after two seconds.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply onClick and return its promise. Throw or reject on failure, including non-OK fetch responses. Reduced motion skips transitions and spinner rotation.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A hold-to-confirm button with a directional color fill and configurable hold duration.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions that require an uninterrupted pointer or keyboard hold.
limitations: onConfirm fires once per completed hold. The caller handles asynchronous work and errors. Confirmation stays visible for two seconds after release before resetting. Click-only activation does not confirm.
requirements: React 19.2 or later, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Phosphor icons, and the shared UI Button. Supply onConfirm in a client component. duration is in seconds; direction is right, left, up, or down.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A shared highlight that travels between focused and selected menu items.

useCases: Sidebar navigation and view selectors with a traveling focus and selection highlight.
limitations: Selection is controlled by the caller. Each item needs a unique value. Keep item overflow visible so the highlight can travel between rows.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Base UI. Supply value and wrap each link or button with MenuItem. Reduced motion switches the highlight instantly.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A shadcn dropdown with open and close transitions and a traveling highlight.

useCases: Action menus with animated open and close transitions and a shared pointer and keyboard highlight.
limitations: Uses the shadcn Base UI variant. Animated highlights cover regular action items and submenu triggers; checkbox items and radio items use the underlying shadcn components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Base UI, and the shadcn Dropdown Menu. Reduced motion removes popup and highlight transitions.

items.name: icon-toggle
items.title: Icon Toggle
items.description: A two-state icon button that morphs its SVG paths on every click.

useCases: Icon toggles with a reversible morph between two states, such as menu and close or play and pause.
limitations: Custom path pairs must use matching SVG commands and coordinate counts in a 24 by 24 viewBox. Uses rounded strokes with no fill. Does not morph arbitrary React icon components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and the shared UI Button. Supply a stable accessible label. Controlled usage requires updating pressed in onPressedChange. Reduced motion switches paths instantly.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider with magnetic stops that catch the thumb and pulse as you slide through them.

useCases: Adjusting values with magnetic catches at meaningful presets or unevenly spaced stops.
limitations: Horizontal single-thumb slider. Feedback is visual and does not vibrate the device. Dense stop labels can overlap.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label and stops. Keyboard input bypasses magnetic snapping. Reduced motion removes animation and preserves snapping.
